name: catalogs-marketing-partners-stores
executionConcern: catalogs, marketing, Partner and Store lifecycle with publication consequences
objective: Close catalogs, marketing, Partner and Store lifecycle with publication consequences end to end without losing canonical ownership, authorization, readback or directly affected surface compatibility.
truthOwner: DSH owns Partner, Store, catalog, availability and operational publication truth; operator writes must become canonical readback on directly affected surfaces.

tasks.objective: Close Partner/Store onboarding, approval, scope and publication
tasks.currentProblem: Partner/Store detail and approval paths can diverge from list state or downstream Partner/Client publication.
tasks.requiredChange: Use canonical DSH Partner/Store state for approval, readiness, scope and publication with audit and readback.
tasks.targetState: Nested and list routes enforce the same authorization; Partner/Client/Field-linked readbacks converge on committed state.
tasks.action: Trace all Partner/Store routes and shared modules to backend/database; repair approval/publication predicates, scope and readback at the owner.
mustNotChange: Do not create parallel domain truth or client-trusted authorization context.
Do not broaden execution into repository areas without a proven Control Panel dependency.
Do not weaken audit, idempotency, conflict or canonical-readback guarantees to make the UI appear successful.
acceptanceCriteria: Nested and list routes enforce the same authorization; Partner/Client/Field-linked readbacks converge on committed state.
Forbidden/wrong-scope and dependency/error states fail explicitly rather than fabricating success.
State-changing actions are verified by canonical readback and directly affected surfaces where applicable.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused implementation commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving audit/data evidence; never restore parallel truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U003 implementation commit after owner correction, affected-consumer migration, cleanup and linked checks.
